title: com.docker.sandbox/mcp-server@1
description: Declares an MCP server a sandbox runs and how an MCP client reaches it. Instance-shaped, keyed on name. An entry without command runs the workload's launch (its entrypoint and cmd) and is workload-only, one per descriptor; any other entry, including every mixin entry, gives its own command. name, transport, port, and path are literal; command and arguments may reference kit args and kit env. The entry grants no permission; the server's reach is the sandbox's own network-policy and credential entries.

name.description: Name an MCP client reaches this server under: one lowercase DNS label, unique within the sandbox.

transport.description: How the server speaks MCP: on its standard streams, or as a streamable-HTTP endpoint at port and path inside the sandbox.

port.description: Port inside the sandbox the streamable-HTTP endpoint listens on. Required for streamable-http, forbidden for stdio.

path.description: Absolute URL path of the streamable-HTTP endpoint, without query or fragment, and with % only as a two-hex-digit escape. Forbidden for stdio.

command.description: Complete command that starts the server inside the sandbox. A string runs via sh -c; a list supplies exec argv. Omit it to run the workload's launch.

arguments.description: Argv that replaces the launch's cmd, as `docker run <image> <args>` would pass it. Only for an entry without command. Elements are strings and may reference ${{ kit.args.<name> }} and ${{ kit.env.<NAME> }}; quote numbers and booleans, which YAML would otherwise decode and re-spell. Omit it to run the launch's cmd.
